enrichment_method.evidence: Phosphopeptides were sequentially enriched using phosphotyrosine immunoprecipitation (IP) and immobilized metal ion chromatography (IMAC).

First, dried samples were resuspended in IP buffer (100 mM Tris·HCl, 1% Nonidet P-40 at pH 7.4) and incubated with protein G agarose beads conjugated with 12 µg 4G10 (Millipore), 12 µg PY-100 (Cell Signaling Technologies), and 12 µg PT-66 (Sigma) overnight at 4°C.
